plain: Buttons now wipe on hover and carry a hard shadow by default, secondary buttons are a soft fill with no border, and overlays, code blocks, tabs, tags and chips lose their resting outline; pass hoverEffect="none" or shadow="none" to a Button to opt out, and <Card bordered> to keep a card edge.

steps.plain: The secondary Button hover fill is now surface.softHover (neutral.300 light, neutral.600 dark); if you set this variable to theme the old outline hover, check it still reads on the soft fill.
The secondary Button pressed fill is now surface.soft (the rest fill) while the hard shadow sinks; re-check any override of this variable.

The secondary Button rest fill is now surface.soft (neutral.200 light, neutral.700 dark) instead of the page colour; set this variable to var(--semantic-color-surface-page) to get the old flat fill back.
The unselected Tag pill is now surface.muted instead of surface.raised; re-check any override of this variable.
The unselected Tag border now matches its fill, so the pill shows no resting edge; set this variable to var(--semantic-color-border-default) to bring the outline back.
The unused .hds-tag-btn rules are gone (Tag has not rendered them since #60); use the Tag component instead of the class.
The unused .hds-tag-pill rules are gone (Tag has not rendered them since #60); use the Tag component instead of the class.
Every primary and secondary Button now has the hard shadow and the hover wipe; pass shadow="none" and/or hoverEffect="none" where a button must stay flat, for example inside a dense toolbar.

Dialog, AlertDialog, Menu, Popover, Select, Toast, CodeBlock, Table, Tabs, SegmentedControl, Combobox chips and TokenField chips no longer draw a resting border; add a className such as border border-border on the instance if your layout relied on that edge.
